card.title: Fluent in Nonsense
card.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To get your sofa off the ceiling, turn the gravity dial politely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm losing my deposit. How do I turn politely?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pause at each number. They dislike being passed over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six clicked, but now the armchairs are rising.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six has invited witnesses. Apologize to the whole suite; private apologies don't count once furniture assembles.

mechanism: A performs mastery of a gravity repair through etiquette rules invented as each practical attempt creates a new problem.
confusable: Unlike stable magical mechanics, A must manufacture a confident explanation only when the next observation requires it.
comparison: Number etiquette becomes group furniture apology, distinct from the bottled cloud's academic anatomy measurements.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
